hints.title: Generating Allowed Digit Combinations
hints.text: Generate candidate numbers consisting purely of digit1 and digit2 in ascending numeric order level by level.

hints.title: 32-Bit Overflow Boundary
hints.text: The search space is naturally bounded: any generated number exceeding 2^31 - 1 can be discarded.

hints.title: Multiple Verification
hints.text: For each generated number strictly greater than k, check if it is divisible by k. Return the first valid multiple.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: D: number of decimal digits fitting in a 32-bit signed integer
complexity.notes: Breadth-first search generating numbers in monotonically increasing order.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating through multiples k, 2k, 3k ... tests up to 2 * 10^9 candidates.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: BFS over digit choices explores at most 2^10 candidates.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that generating candidates by digits is vastly smaller than scanning multiples of k.
